content.short: Dungeon of Kitsu is a deck-building roguelike on TON featuring base-building and NFT mechanics.
content.description: Dungeon of Kitsu is an immersive and strategic blockchain game built on the TON network that blends deck-building roguelike elements with persistent base-building. Players explore challenging digital dungeons, battle epic bosses, and collect rare NFT-based cards to enhance their abilities. The game features a rewarding Play-to-Earn economy where players can earn $KITSU tokens for their achievements and strategic mastery. With its deep gameplay mechanics and true ownership of in-game assets, Dungeon of Kitsu is a standout title in the TON gaming ecosystem.
content.meta: Explore dungeons and earn rewards in Dungeon of Kitsu on TON. Deck-building roguelike with NFTs on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
